overview: A good listing helps the right shopper understand the product in seconds. For each product we research the category rules, write a clear title, bullets and description, choose the category and attributes, and prepare your photos to the marketplace's size and background rules. We create the listing in your own seller account as a draft for your review, then publish once you approve.

faq: Do you need my product photos?

Yes, please send the best ones you have. We check them against the marketplace's size and background rules and tell you what needs reshooting. We do not use photos taken from other sellers or websites.
Can you list restricted or gated products?
We can prepare the application and the listing, but approval for gated categories such as supplements or beauty is decided by the marketplace. We never get around those checks.
Amazon, eBay, Etsy and Walmart Marketplace are the most common. Tell us in the order form where you sell, and we confirm which rules apply before we start writing.
Do you write the product claims?
We use only claims you can support, such as materials and sizes you give us. We avoid health, safety and comparison claims that marketplaces restrict, and we do not copy text from other listings.
